findings.detail: The proposal binds one TRACKER task and exactly two tracker output write paths: the live tracker journal and dashboard JSON. It grants no application source, client configuration or production write. The purpose is limited to the user-requested bounded dashboard/tracker work.

The host/boot binding matches current observation; all 21 loaded BEAM control IDs match the current runtime; tools/ecology_process.ml digest matches current bytes. The fresh tracker review risk preflight and active-check passed under the independent reviewer identity and canonical task attempt1.

All 16 declared source paths exist in canonical root. Effect-time capture must hash those canonical-root bytes; the implementation hard-codes dev.root to /home/an/NAS-setup/uos. Re-capture and bind those bytes for each effect; V2 ACTIVATE receipts do not authorize TRACKER effects.

The declared toolchain preflight reports candidate workspace `.uos-workspaces/dev-harness-20261028-0105` 31 checks PASS, while canonical root remains FAIL for preserved ignored/unadmitted verify_guardian.exe. Current candidate has a local change to apps/cepaf_gleam/test/harness_development_test.gleam and a .pixi symlink not present in canonical root. The public grant does not declare candidate equivalence; build/test, if needed for canonical completion, must use current canonical-root source capture and must not claim the dirty candidate as the tested source.

Grant expires at 2026-10-28T05:05:00Z, within the 24-hour admission bound. Its two writes support bounded tracker snapshots; no automatic ten-minute scheduling is established. Six test modules are finite development test scope and should only be run if required by the task completion contract.

limits: This review approves only the exact finite TRACKER development grant, not recurring scheduler enforcement, complete MCP command acceptance, client parity, concurrency, production behavior or global UOS admission.
No canonical-root clean/green claim: the ignored/unadmitted guardian failure remains preserved and unexecuted.
The candidate workspace differs from root at one declared test path; its 31-check preflight is not equivalent to the effect-time source manifest.
A review result and risk pass do not authorize effects; actual claim, fresh task/grant/host/boot/control fences and exact output readbacks remain required.
required_before_finish: Finalize a grant derived exactly from this proposal with this review digest and fresh source/control/host/boot validation; refresh the target session before claim.
Use only the two declared tracker write paths and capture exact output readbacks. Any build/test receipt must bind the then-current canonical-root manifest and tracker grant/task attempt.
Describe the output as a bounded snapshot unless an actual scheduler/refresh mechanism is separately implemented and observed.
